reasons.BACNET_UNITS_TEMPERATURE_SETPOINT: Recognized BACnet temperature unit, on an output or a setpoint-like name.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_TEMPERATURE: Temperature keyword found in the name, with no usable BACnet unit.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_PRESSURE: Pressure keyword found in the name, with no usable BACnet unit.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_FAULT: Fault keyword found in the name.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_RUN: Run/status keyword found in the name.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_ENABLE: Enable keyword found in the name.
reasons.NAME_KEYWORD_COMMAND: Binary output named like a run command.
reasons.NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL: No unit or keyword reliable enough: needs review by a person.
reasons.MULTISTATE_NOT_YET_MAPPED: No generic multi-state point class in the vocabulary yet: needs review by a person.
